clue.text: Product of volcano rolling around eruptive side?

indicators.note: around tells us the first scrambled piece goes outside the second
rolling means turned over, so the volcano's name is rearranged

parts.note: Etna is the active volcano in Sicily

indicators.note: eruptive suggests bursting apart, so the letters of side are rearranged

explanation.surface: Lava from a volcano flows round the side where it erupts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rolling' rearranges ETNA, the volcano, into ANTE (an indirect anagram); 'eruptive' turns SIDE into DESI; 'around' puts ANTE round DESI. The question mark admits the volcano also colours the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Andesite is a fine-grained volcanic rock, named after the Andes, formed from cooled lava.

clue.text: Warm state, Idaho

clue.text: King received in absolute awe

explanation.definitionFit: Dread is deep fear, close to the fearful reverence of awe.
